# CyberUtsav Lumbini

> CyberUtsav Lumbini is a free, 3-day student hackathon in Butwal, Nepal, held January 15–17, 2027 — the Lumbini Provincial Chapter of CyberUtsav, Nepal's largest student hackathon series. Teams of 3 compete across 6 tracks, and winning teams advance to the CyberUtsav Grand Finale in Kathmandu. Registration is open and free: https://registration.cyberutsav.com/butwal

## Key facts
- **Event:** CyberUtsav Lumbini (Lumbini Provincial Chapter of CyberUtsav)
- **Parent series:** CyberUtsav, organized by Tech Gurkha Digital Services (https://cyberutsav.com)
- **Co-organizer:** ButwalHacks, Butwal's student developer community (https://butwalhacks.com)
- **Location:** Butwal, Lumbini Province, Nepal — venue is a partner institution, to be announced
- **Dates:** January 15–17, 2027 (3 days)
- **Format:** 3 days on-site — 6-hour build sprint (Day 1), 7-hour sprint (Day 2), judging and award ceremony (Day 3); 13 hours of building in total
- **Food:** High tea and lunch served all three days
- **Team size:** Exactly 3 members (one team leader + two members)
- **Eligibility:** High school students, A-Levels students, and recent graduates
- **Capacity:** Up to 150 participants
- **Cost:** Free (Rs. 0)
- **Tracks:** Cybersecurity, AI/ML, IoT & Hardware, Web Development, Social Impact, Open Innovation
- **Advancement:** Winners advance directly to the Kathmandu Grand Finale
- **Prizes:** Grand prize, per-track prizes, swag for every participant and career opportunities — amounts to be announced
- **Round:** Provincial city qualifier
- **Status:** Registration open now

## Frequently asked questions

### How do I register?
Register at https://registration.cyberutsav.com/butwal. It is free and takes less than 2 minutes. Register as a team of 3.

### Is it free?
Yes. There is no registration fee.

### Who can participate?
High school students, A-Levels students, and recent graduates, in teams of exactly 3.

### When is it?
January 15–17, 2027, in Butwal, Lumbini Province, Nepal. The exact venue (a partner institution) will be announced soon.

### How long is it?
3 days on-site (January 15–17, 2027) with 13 hours of building in total.

### What is the daily schedule?
- **Day 1 — Fri, Jan 15 (Opening & Build Sprint):** 09:00 check-in · 09:30 opening ceremony · 10:30 high tea · 11:00–17:00 hackathon sprint (6 hours), lunch 13:00–14:00 served during the build
- **Day 2 — Sat, Jan 16 (Build & Mentorship):** 09:00 check-in · 09:30 high tea · 10:00–17:00 hackathon (7 hours), lunch 13:00–14:00 served during the build
- **Day 3 — Sun, Jan 17 (Judgement & Awards):** 09:00 check-in · 09:30 high tea · 10:00–13:00 judging · 13:00 lunch · 14:00–16:00 judging continues · 16:00 networking · 16:30–17:30 award ceremony

### Is food provided?
Yes. High tea and lunch are served on all three days.

### What do winners get?
Direct entry to the CyberUtsav Grand Finale in Kathmandu. Lumbini prize details will be announced once confirmed with sponsors.

### Is CyberUtsav Lumbini the same as CyberUtsav 3.0?
No. CyberUtsav 3.0 is the current edition of the national series; CyberUtsav Lumbini is one provincial chapter of it — a regional selection round in Butwal whose winners go on to the national Grand Finale in Kathmandu.
